title.narrative: EuroMed Transport Support Projec

description.narrative: The project aims to support the Southern Mediterranean Partner Countries in the implementation of the Regional Transport Action Plan 2014-2020. This project will cover efficiency and safety of all transport modes, with a particular attention to multimodal transport and land transport. The activities will be concentrated on technical assistance, the exchange of best practices and training.
